index 0000000..ee441da

+++ b/internal/cache/redis/client.go
@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+
+	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+// NewClient constructs a Redis client from the cache configuration.
+func NewClient(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*goredis.Client, error) {
+	if cfg.CaCertPath != "" && cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path")
+	}
+
+	var tlsConfig *tls.Config
+	if cfg.RequireTLS {
+		tlsConfig = &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS} //nolint:gosec // Explicit user configuration.
+
+		var cert []byte
+		if cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+			var err error
+			cert, err = os.ReadFile(cfg.CaCertPath)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading Redis CA certificate: %w", err)
+			}
+		} else if cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+			cert = []byte(cfg.CaCertBytes)
+		}
+
+		if len(cert) > 0 {
+			roots, err := x509.SystemCertPool()
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("loading system certificate authorities: %w", err)
+			}
+			if roots == nil {
+				roots = x509.NewCertPool()
+			}
+			if !roots.AppendCertsFromPEM(cert) {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid Redis CA certificate")
+			}
+			tlsConfig.RootCAs = roots
+		}
+	}
+
+	return goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{
+		Addr:            fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", cfg.Host, cfg.Port),
+		TLSConfig:       tlsConfig,
+		Username:        cfg.Username,
+		Password:        cfg.Password,
+		DB:              cfg.DB,
+		PoolSize:        cfg.PoolSize,
+		MinIdleConns:    cfg.MinIdleConn,
+		ConnMaxIdleTime: cfg.ConnMaxIdleTime,
+		DialTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout,
+		ReadTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		WriteTimeout:    cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		PoolTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+	}), nil
+}
diff --git a/internal/cache/redis/client_test.go b/internal/cache/redis/client_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..85ada03
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/cache/redis/client_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/ecdsa"
+	"crypto/elliptic"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"crypto/x509/pkix"
+	"encoding/pem"
+	"math/big"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+func TestNewClientTLS(t *testing.T) {
+	key, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	template := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "redis test CA"},
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
+	}
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, template, template, &key.PublicKey, key)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	cert := pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der})
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ca.pem")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, cert, 0600))
+
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  config.RedisCacheConfig
+	}{
+		{"system roots", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true}},
+		{"inline CA", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: string(cert)}},
+		{"CA path", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: path}},
+		{"insecure", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, InsecureSkipTLS: true}},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			if tc.cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+				data, err := os.ReadFile(tc.cfg.CaCertPath)
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				require.Equal(t, cert, data)
+			}
+			client, err := NewClient(tc.cfg)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer client.Close()
+			opts := client.Options()
+			require.Equal(t, uint16(tls.VersionTLS12), opts.TLSConfig.MinVersion)
+			require.Equal(t, tc.cfg.InsecureSkipTLS, opts.TLSConfig.InsecureSkipVerify)
+			if tc.cfg.CaCertPath == "" && tc.cfg.CaCertBytes == "" {
+				require.Nil(t, opts.TLSConfig.RootCAs)
+			} else {
+				require.NotNil(t, opts.TLSConfig.RootCAs)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNewClientWithoutTLS(t *testing.T) {
+	client, err := NewClient(config.RedisCacheConfig{Host: "localhost", Port: 6379})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer client.Close()
+	require.Nil(t, client.Options().TLSConfig)
+}
+
+func TestNewClientErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name    string
+		cfg     config.RedisCacheConfig
+		message string
+	}{
+		{"conflicting CAs", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: "x", CaCertBytes: "x"}, "please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path"},
+		{"missing CA", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: "missing-ca.pem"}, "reading Redis CA certificate"},
+		{"invalid CA", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: "invalid"}, "invalid Redis CA certificate"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			client, err := NewClient(tc.cfg)
+			require.ErrorContains(t, err, tc.message)
+			require.Nil(t, client)
+		})
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+
+	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+// NewClient constructs a Redis client from the cache configuration.
+func NewClient(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*goredis.Client, error) {
+	if cfg.CaCertPath != "" && cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path")
+	}
+
+	var tlsConfig *tls.Config
+	if cfg.RequireTLS {
+		tlsConfig = &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS} //nolint:gosec // Explicit user configuration.
+
+		var cert []byte
+		if cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+			var err error
+			cert, err = os.ReadFile(cfg.CaCertPath)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading Redis CA certificate: %w", err)
+			}
+		} else if cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+			cert = []byte(cfg.CaCertBytes)
+		}
+
+		if len(cert) > 0 {
+			roots, err := x509.SystemCertPool()
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("loading system certificate authorities: %w", err)
+			}
+			if roots == nil {
+				roots = x509.NewCertPool()
+			}
+			if !roots.AppendCertsFromPEM(cert) {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid Redis CA certificate")
+			}
+			tlsConfig.RootCAs = roots
+		}
+	}
+
+	return goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{
+		Addr:            fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", cfg.Host, cfg.Port),
+		TLSConfig:       tlsConfig,
+		Username:        cfg.Username,
+		Password:        cfg.Password,
+		DB:              cfg.DB,
+		PoolSize:        cfg.PoolSize,
+		MinIdleConns:    cfg.MinIdleConn,
+		ConnMaxIdleTime: cfg.ConnMaxIdleTime,
+		DialTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout,
+		ReadTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		WriteTimeout:    cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		PoolTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+	}), nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/ecdsa"
+	"crypto/elliptic"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"crypto/x509/pkix"
+	"encoding/pem"
+	"math/big"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+func TestNewClientTLS(t *testing.T) {
+	key, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	template := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "redis test CA"},
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
+	}
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, template, template, &key.PublicKey, key)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	cert := pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der})
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ca.pem")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, cert, 0600))
+
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  config.RedisCacheConfig
+	}{
+		{"system roots", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true}},
+		{"inline CA", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: string(cert)}},
+		{"CA path", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: path}},
+		{"insecure", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, InsecureSkipTLS: true}},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			if tc.cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+				data, err := os.ReadFile(tc.cfg.CaCertPath)
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				require.Equal(t, cert, data)
+			}
+			client, err := NewClient(tc.cfg)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer client.Close()
+			opts := client.Options()
+			require.Equal(t, uint16(tls.VersionTLS12), opts.TLSConfig.MinVersion)
+			require.Equal(t, tc.cfg.InsecureSkipTLS, opts.TLSConfig.InsecureSkipVerify)
+			if tc.cfg.CaCertPath == "" && tc.cfg.CaCertBytes == "" {
+				require.Nil(t, opts.TLSConfig.RootCAs)
+			} else {
+				require.NotNil(t, opts.TLSConfig.RootCAs)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNewClientWithoutTLS(t *testing.T) {
+	client, err := NewClient(config.RedisCacheConfig{Host: "localhost", Port: 6379})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer client.Close()
+	require.Nil(t, client.Options().TLSConfig)
+}
+
+func TestNewClientErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name    string
+		cfg     config.RedisCacheConfig
+		message string
+	}{
+		{"conflicting CAs", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: "x", CaCertBytes: "x"}, "please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path"},
+		{"missing CA", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: "missing-ca.pem"}, "reading Redis CA certificate"},
+		{"invalid CA", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: "invalid"}, "invalid Redis CA certificate"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			client, err := NewClient(tc.cfg)
+			require.ErrorContains(t, err, tc.message)
+			require.Nil(t, client)
+		})
+	}
+}
